no_search.bear_case_summary: Tesla's current valuation of $426.04 is mathematically detached from fundamental reality, driven by extreme speculative fervor. The Reverse DCF requires an impossible 80.0% 10-year revenue CAGR, which is 4.8x its historical rate and 5.3x the sector's 75th percentile. Furthermore, the Liberti Multiple Decomposition reveals a market EV/EBITDA of 158.3x, a staggering +6045% premium over the mathematically justified multiple of 2.6x. Agent-proposed scenarios universally point to catastrophic downside. Even the 'Robotaxi & AI Breakthrough' bull scenario (proposed by context) yields an IPS of only $36.94 (-91.3% downside). The 'Energy Storage Dominance' base_alternative scenario (proposed by value_chain) offers an IPS of $38.12 (-91.1%). The most realistic downside path is captured in the 'EV Commoditization & AI Delay' bear scenario (proposed by forensic), which drops the IPS to $20.31 (-95.2% downside). If FSD and Robotaxi fail to achieve regulatory approval, Tesla will be valued purely as a hardware automaker facing intense Chinese competition and permanent margin compression. Ultimately, the absolute bear case DCF models a $0/share intrinsic value (-100% downside), a highly probable outcome if core auto margins collapse under price wars while massive, unrecoverable AI capex destroys all remaining shareholder value.
